headings: # P5.2.0-B Career Domain Independence & Persistence Architecture
### Every v11 table and reference family
## Domain API and persistence port design
decisions: Date: 2026-11-01. **PARTIAL / BLOCKED for completion and formal page migration.**
| Rollback retaining post-migration new writes | **BLOCKED**, explicit rollbackAfterWrites rejection |
| Full legacy browser bridge / complete reference and file integrity | PARTIAL; fake IndexedDB and bounded reference validator only |
| Plugin validated production writes | BLOCKED; API spike denies them all |

Rollback must not switch back to the old export after new service writes. Required protocol: fence new commands, drain transaction queue, produce a final checkpoint plus complete ordered post-cutover journal with stable operation IDs/versions/evidence/bytes, replay through canonical reverse adapter to a **new isolated** legacy-compatible database, validate hash/count/reference/receipt parity, then atomically change authority. Preserve old and new snapshots/journal until user acceptance; if replay is unsupported, retain the service data and refuse rollback/cutover. No dual writer or discarded new revisions. This protocol is not implemented or tested; old-source existence alone is not rollback

Thus **P5.2.0-B is PARTIAL; completion and formal page migration are BLOCKED**. No P5.2.0-C, FINAL GO, P5.2.1 or page migration is authorized by this result. The remaining work belongs to this B contract and requires review, not an automatic next stage.

**SQLite 引擎原则可行，生产组合 NO-GO/BLOCKED。** B2-A 只定义五实体临时表、user_version=1、BEGIN IMMEDIATE/有限busy等待、tagged codec；没有完整 metadata/proposal、生产 ownership lock、备份恢复、跨版本迁移/反向journal。没有外键或新增 revision uniqueness，不能为了“加固”改变 canonical put/历史语义。sqlite3/better-sqlite3 不是当前已批准安装的替代。解除条件：受支持且稳定等级/维护策略明确的精确runtime及SQLite实现、可重现bundle哈希/平台资格、备份恢复和升级崩溃门禁。若需新依赖或接受RC发行策略，另行报告并取得明确决定；本轮不批准。
| proposal.confirm | proposalId、proposalHash、scope、user gesture challenge → 单次receipt | broker可信确认入口；会话/来源/目标/版本绑定 |

响应：`{apiVersion,requestId,serviceEpoch,operationId?,status,result? ,error?:{code,retryable,outcome}}`。outcome区分notStarted/rolledBack/committed/unknown。错误至少：INVALID_REQUEST、UNSUPPORTED_VERSION、FORBIDDEN、NOT_FOUND、REVISION_CONFLICT、OPERATION_ID_REUSE、CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED、CONFIRMATION_STALE、FACT_GUARD_BLOCKED、REFERENCE_INVALID、DEADLINE_EXCEEDED、CANCELLED、SERVICE_RESTARTED、SQLITE_BUSY、DATABASE_CORRUPT、SCHEMA_TOO_NEW、STORAGE_ERROR。禁止回传路径、SQL、个人数据全文或stack给UI，内部日志以request/operation ID关联。

确认不能由不可信Renderer自报。服务持有proposal和精确diff，可信broker显示/核验与hash绑定的用户确认；如锁定Host没有可用独立可信确认表面，生产AI写入仍BLOCKED，不能用SDK完整权限作“用户同意”证明。已有Repository confirmAsResumeOnly只是内部业务参数，服务须验证receipt后才设置，Profile同步必须独立确认。proposal/receipt消费与写入应进入同一UoW；如果现有 appMeta 单独consume无法原子组合，不做consume→write两事务补偿式上线。

10. Schema migration由唯一authority、启动READY前、独占维护模式执行；记录版本/校验和，先一致性备份，事务化升级；未知新schema fail closed。B2-A user_version1不是Resume Schema v2或Dexie v11，三者不得混用。禁止旧程序打开新库写入；软件回退依赖可验证兼容或带新写入的反向journal，父B这项仍BLOCKED。
| Plugin Renderer | 展示/编辑建议；SDK同realm不是安全边界；不得持密钥、DB路径、raw SQL或可信确认权 |
| Host Bridge | 校验会话/来源、operation allowlist、scope、大小/频率，可信确认与通道凭据；SDK现有profile-aware路由仍须Career ownership复验 |
插件供应链：固定获准来源及包hash、依赖/构建产物审计；hash只证明字节一致。恶意同realm插件能操作UI/共享Host权限，现有SDK不能保证真实用户点击与插件伪造点击可区分；这是残余高风险，未经可信Host确认设计和验证前不开放AI事实写入。Python后端插件同样是受信任代码而非沙箱，不允许其凭UI传来的路径启动服务/读取文件。
| 1 | 无Core改动SDK/backend broker可行性与可信确认技术验证 | 真实锁定Host ctx.rest route/auth/profile隔离、断连和禁用，合成数据；不能验证则停在BLOCKED，不写生产服务 |
| TRUSTED_CONFIRMATION | 可信确认表面及server-held hash/receipt；同realm插件威胁不能靠Renderer标记解决 |

Date: 2026-11-02. **PARTIAL**. Read-only transport works in the real locked Desktop; plugin disable is not a connection-revocation boundary. Overall gate is NO-GO for the proposed trusted write architecture.

Three bounded Host runs exited 0 with no page errors, all explicitly PARTIAL: first basic observation, second adds confirmation surface/negative requests and child crash, final reruns the same chain after tightening the integer protocol-version check to reject JSON true. Exit 0 means observation script completed; it does **not** mean the required feasibility gate passed. No run timed out. Raw JSON and log hashes are linked in the evidence manifest. The final run used final source bytes.

Startup READY here is broker process-launch readiness; first hello establishes actual protocol readiness. Production readiness handshake, crash-before-hello, Host abrupt-kill/orphan reaping, automatic backend shutdown hook, already-running request revocation during disable and cross-platform IPC are **NOT QUALIFIED**. Host restart was tested with explicit broker close before shutdown; it does not prove orphan-free crash cleanup. These are reasons to retain PARTIAL, not claims of completed lifecycle qualification.

2026-11-02. **BLOCKED for production release approval**. Research complete within scope; no production runtime is approved. No dependency was installed, no Career database was opened, and no runtime upgrade or package was produced.
| Production qualification | BLOCKED | BLOCKED | BLOCKED |

Even a fully qualified runtime cannot repair the missing trusted Host confirmation or Renderer-disable revocation. Releasing a write-capable Domain Service is NO-GO under this gate. Before any later production authorization: pin/hash/license a supported runtime and engine per platform; prove canonical rule parity, unique ownership, backup/restore, compatible updates, crash/orphan/unknown-outcome handling and independent confirmation. No further stage is started.

headings: ## Required design, not an implemented authority
decisions: 2026-11-02. **BLOCKED** for locked Hermes 0.19.0 at eb527605. No provably trusted Host approval issuer exists in the audited public plugin path. No Core modification or write endpoint was implemented.

Real Host requests to proposal.confirm with confirmed=true, wrong hash, foreign Profile, replay-shaped receipt, stale revision and cancelled=true all return INVALID_REQUEST because the read-only Fake Service does not expose confirmation or apply. Protocol tests assert that no result accompanies these refusals. This proves fail-closed unsupported operations only. It does **not** validate hash mismatch, cross-Profile receipt, revision, expiry, duplicate receipt or late-cancel behavior of an implemented trusted mechanism. Positive issuance, successful one-time consumption and each dedicated receipt rejection gate are **NOT RUN / BLOCKED**, not PASS. No facts, preview, PDF or formal data were wr

Under the stipulated independent-Host-confirmation architecture, a new Core extension would be needed to establish the missing issuer through this SDK. Task instructions prohibit that modification and require BLOCKED. Work on that path stops here. No user permission is inferred from a synthetic UI click or test harness event. Parent production migration remains BLOCKED; overall feasibility is NO-GO for trusted writes under the present constraints. Read-only transport remains a separate PARTIAL result.
